MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo Show 8 feels like a useful addition to my Fire TV setup because its screen could let me view camera feeds, provided my cameras are supported.",
    "The Blink bundle fits my interest in home monitoring and could extend my existing Blink setup with doorbell and indoor coverage, after I check compatibility."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Earbuds and a portable speaker do not address my current focus on home video and security; owning electronics does not mean I need more audio devices.",
    "Memory cards and a USB hub would only be useful if I had a specific storage or connection need. My camera and monitor purchases alone do not establish that need.",
    "The Echo Dot adds voice access I already have through my Fire TV remote. The Show 5 and WYZE camera interest me, but I would choose the larger Show 8 and expand Blink first."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My electronics purchases seem to have been treated as broad interest in gadgets, even when those gadgets serve unrelated purposes.",
    "My use of Alexa and cameras seems to have been taken as a reason to add any Alexa device or camera accessory, without a clear additional use for it."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "What matters now is whether an item adds a useful capability to my existing home entertainment or monitoring setup and works with the devices I already own.",
    "My existing Blink camera makes a compatible expansion more appealing than starting another camera system, and a larger display is more useful to me for viewing feeds.",
    "I choose equipment when it meets a concrete need; storage capacity, extra ports, and another voice device are not needs I have identified."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in connected home video and security, but often stretch that interest into gadgets and accessories without a clear purpose in my setup."
}
